full_judgment: "In an inquiry in a proceeding under section 145 CrPC the main question relates to the factum of possession of the disputed land and it appears that the learned Magistrate had decided this question upon consideration of evidences. The learned Sessions Judge came to an independent finding on the question of possession mainly on the basis of certain documentary evidences and found fault with the learned Magistrate for not taking into consideration the Patta of the second party but it appears that the learned Magistrate had discarded the Patta as it was not properly proved. The learned Sessions Judge has not been able to show tow the finding of the learned Magistrate on the question of possession is vitiated by any illegality or due to non-consideration of any material evidence which would have had a bearing on the finding.
